---
title: "Penguin Lab"
---

Welcome. This is a small site about the **Palmer penguins**: three species measured at Palmer
Station, Antarctica, shipped in base R as `datasets::penguins` (R ≥ 4.5).

Head to the **[analysis](analysis.qmd)** for the figures and a summary table.

> This folder is your starting point for the Day-2 lab: two pages that render on their own but are
> **not yet a project**. Your job is to add a `_quarto.yml` (and a `_brand.yml`) that turn them into a
> navigable, branded website, then ship it.
